reviews.name: Pasture
reviews.premise: Moss green leads; lake blue and umber brown stay in support. The green is olive and deep, so it never competes with the bright signed-off green the gates already use.
logo_ideas: A single-stroke shepherd's crook: a vertical stem rising into a hooked arc, drawn on one grid
A low fold arc sheltering three small discs
A hill horizon with one point held above it

reviews.name: Loam
reviews.premise: Umber brown leads, which is rare in software tooling and shares no hue with any status colour. Moss and lake read as the living things on brown earth.
logo_ideas: A crook cut as negative space out of a solid umber field
A gate: two posts with one lifted bar
A cairn of three stacked stones

reviews.name: Lakeside
reviews.premise: Slate lake blue leads with moss and umber as the shore. Cooler and more technical; the slate is distinct from the sky blue that means running.
logo_ideas: A crook whose hook holds one lake-blue disc
A fold arc over three discs in two tones
A horizon line with a single north point
